deadline.value: Apply by 11:59pm PST, December 1, 2026 for Autumn 2027; no late applications.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Autumn 2027 entry is December 1, 2026, at 11:59pm (PST).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for chemical engineering.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are neither required nor accepted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are no longer required or accepted as part of an applicant’s application materials.

supervisor.value: First-year students rotate in two research groups before choosing an advisor.
supervisor.quote: Each first-year PhD student rotates with two different faculty research groups before choosing an advisor and lab in which to develop his or her own research projects.

funding.value: The School of Engineering commits to full funding for all PhDs; virtually all first-year ChemE PhD students receive aid.
funding.quote: Stanford Engineering commits to full funding for all PhDs.

also.quote: virtually all the first-year PhD students in Chemical Engineering receive aid

entry_route.value: Open to anyone with (or about to finish) a bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: Our Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) program is open to all applicants who have completed a bachelor’s degree or will have completed one before matriculating as a graduate student at Stanford.
